svg.text: Happy path with every security layer
One deposit, from login to notification. Each gate checks one thing, and each one can say no.
Login happens directly with Keycloak. This service never sees the password,
it only checks the token Keycloak signed.
allowed in: the request is now authenticated, within its rate, valid, owned and not a repeat
Lock the account row: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE (3 s lock timeout)
Update the balance and write the ledger entry
Insert the outbox row and write the audit entry
Commit: all of it, or none of it
201 Created goes straight back to the client. Everything below happens after it.
Stateless: no session, no cookies, so CSRF is off on purpose
Errors are RFC 7807 problem details; a 500 never shows internals
Every log line carries the correlation id
Public: health, info, metrics, API docs. Anything else is denied
ASYNCHRONOUS · after the 201, not on the request path
Kafka has no authentication or encryption in
this project (ADR-003). Consumers trust the topic.
In production: TLS, SASL, and ACLs per topic,
and only the relay may write to accounts.events.
Retries, dead letters and replay for this part are on the failure scenario pages.
Authentication proves who you are. Authorization says what your role may do. Ownership says what is yours. Each layer is checked on its own, so one mistake does not open the door. After the
checks, the limits service must say yes, one transaction changes the money and writes the event, and the client gets its 201 before Kafka is involved.
Not shown, because they sit outside the service: TLS and the gateway in front of it.
